sourceTitle: Completo Hot Dog -- Best Dog Of Life
sourceText:
Completo Hot Dog -- Best Dog Of Life
By: Aldy
Published: Sunday, June 6, 2010 - 4:22pm

Ingredients




Completo Recipe

Serves 2-3

4 Hot-dogs buns
4 Frankfurters/hot dogs
1 large avocado, mashed
2 mediums tomatoes, diced
Mayonnaise

Salt

Preparation

1 Preparation: 2 Cook the Frankfurters in boiling water for a couple minutes. In the meantime prepare buns and toppings; cut buns in half and spread mayonnaise, place the frankfurters/hot dogs in each bun and top with diced tomatoes and mashed avocado. Add salt to taste and mayonnaise. Serve immediately.

About


This Hot Dog is a Unique Creation of Chile and is called “Completo” in spanish/meaning “Complete”. And as you can see in the picture, it is a very different version of the usual basic hot-dogs. This one I've made is called Completo Italiano meaning Italian Completo. Why? Chilean says; because their colors are similar to those of the Italian flag. The  toppings are: mashed avocado; diced tomato and mayonnaise.  There are others variations of Chilean Hot Dogs but this is the one that I liked the most and the first one I tried in my first trip to Chile. Also one of the best I've ever had. Hubby J. and I love “Completos” especially on the weekends, when we are extremely hungry but also in hurry-- many things to do and such a short day! I usually serve the completo with mix salad but you can also serve it with French fries. My- oh- My there’s nothing more Delicious!
